devices.name: Pulse 4K
devices.techSpecs:
QuickVu 4K (QVU-4K)
Entry-level presentation switcher.
1× 4K Program + 1× Full HD AUX output.
Mixer mode only.
No edge blending.


QuickMatrix 4K (QMX-4K)
Dual-output presentation switcher.
2× independent 4K Program outputs.
Matrix mode only.
No edge blending.


Pulse 4K (PLS-4K)
Flexible presentation switcher.
2× independent 4K outputs in Matrix mode.
1× 4K Program + AUX in Mixer mode.
No edge blending.


Eikos 4K (EKS-4K)
Advanced presentation switcher.
Same Matrix and Mixer capabilities as Pulse 4K.
Adds hard/soft edge blending for projection.


Common features: 10 video inputs, dedicated multiviewer, fixed video I/O, mirrored HDMI/SDI outputs, optional Analog + Dante audio card, 2U chassis and 95 W maximum power consumption.
